scope: Post-evaluation diagnostic stratification only. No training, candidate selection by subset, replacement forecast, promotion or prospective claim.
origin_trend: Difference between exact approved Muçum level at the anchor(origin-15min) and at anchor-3h, divided by3. Both observations must match frozen raw levels. Intermediate missing samples do not turn endpoint net change into continuous monotonicity.
threshold_role: Fixed analyst diagnostic threshold, not a warning rule, calibrated hydrological phase or accuracy tolerance.
events: Use existing flood-event-grouping-policy.json on source observations with explicit approved QC only. Preserve gaps, censoring and missing datum/timezone verification. Clusters remain uncertified. Associate only exact high target observations, never choose events by error.
metrics: By nominal horizon, origin trend and target>=7m versus all: preserve pair counts and failures; compare MAE,bias,fraction within0.50m. Also report every observed high-target cluster separately, including clusters without calculable forecasts.
non_goal_evidence: All predictions remain historical development from previously inspected periods. No overlapping predictions are counted as independent floods. No confidence interval is inferred from IID hourly samples.
